partnership.title: Terms
partnership.intro: When you win, we win. There are no fees to advance: our collaboration is built around the product's success, not billing for services.
partnership.visualAlt: Two complementary forms representing our partnership
partnership.workText: We take care of the application's strategy, design and development, from the first concept through growth: launch, sales funnels, marketing and continuous optimization.
partnership.modelText: In return, we take an equity stake in the project and a share of the revenue it generates. The terms are agreed together before we begin.
partnership.eligibilityText: This model is reserved for creators who have already built an engaged community of more than 150,000 followers.
